grades.quote: FENCE.I does _not_ ensure that other RISC-V harts' instruction fetches will observe the local hart’s stores in a multiprocessor system. To make a store to instruction memory visible to all RISC-V harts, the writing hart also has to execute a data FENCE before requesting that all remote RISC-V harts execute a FENCE.I.
grades.reason: Directly states that local FENCE.I does not synchronize other harts and explains the required coordination.
Discusses local ASIDs and address-translation caches, not FENCE.I instruction-fetch synchronization.
